description: Data for "Future impacts of river flow on hydropower generation in Great Britain is a data set deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors Ana-Diana Golgojan. This dataset contains detailed information about climate changes to run of river hydropower in Great Britain in the near (2030-2059) and far future (2050-2079) from the baseline (1980-2009). Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 1832MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
